WITH store_sales_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 THEN '1-20'
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40 THEN '21-40'
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN '41-60'
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80 THEN '61-80'
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100 THEN '81-100'
        END AS range,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) AS avg_ext_tax,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax
    FROM store_sales
    GROUP BY range
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT CASE WHEN cnt > 1071 THEN avg_ext_tax ELSE avg_net_paid_inc_tax END
     FROM store_sales_summary
     WHERE range = '1-20') AS bucket1,
    (SELECT CASE WHEN cnt > 2140 THEN avg_ext_tax ELSE avg_net_paid_inc_tax END
     FROM store_sales_summary
     WHERE range = '21-40') AS bucket2,
    (SELECT CASE WHEN cnt > 2140 THEN avg_ext_tax ELSE avg_net_paid_inc_tax END
     FROM store_sales_summary
     WHERE range = '41-60') AS bucket3,
    (SELECT CASE WHEN cnt > 2140 THEN avg_ext_tax ELSE avg_net_paid_inc_tax END
     FROM store_sales_summary
     WHERE range = '61-80') AS bucket4,
    (SELECT CASE WHEN cnt > 2140 THEN avg_ext_tax ELSE avg_net_paid_inc_tax END
     FROM store_sales_summary
     WHERE range = '81-100') AS bucket5
FROM reason
WHERE r_reason_sk = 1
